decision_titles: Hiring of Brandon Yerger as Fire Apparatus Mechanic
plain_text:
MINUTES OF THE AUGUST 17, 2026 SPECIAL FIRE COMMISSION MEETING 
PRESENT: Mayor Ellen Zoppo-Sassu and Commissioners Tony Benvenuto, Hal Kilby, Dana Jandreau and 
Peter Kelley. Absent: Sandra Bogdanski 
Also Present: Chief Rick Hart 
The meeting was called to order at 5pm and a quorum was declared.  
Chief Hart gave an overview of the candidate that has been recommended by the Human Resources 
Department. He also stated that he had the opportunity to meet with the candidate on Saturday, and 
was very impressed with his mechanical credentials.  
The motion was made by Commissioner Kilby and seconded by Commissioner Jandreau to approve the 
hiring of Brandon Yerger for the position of Fire Apparatus Mechanic, effective September 8, 2026.  
The motion was unanimously approved.  
There being no further business, the meeting was at 5:13pm adjourned by motion of Commissioner 
Benvenuto, seconded by Councilman Kelley.  
Respectfully Submitted, 
Ellen Zoppo-Sassu 
Chair
